_about: How much a figure may claim. Run by tests/test_shared_cases.py and frontend/src/shared.cases.test.ts.

means.why: three good-mood days can't claim anything, however big the gap
a clear gap over five each is a preliminary signal
a clear gap over twelve each is an emerging pattern
a large sample with a small, noisy gap can't be told apart
a large sample with a gap inside two standard errors stays preliminary
two flat groups that differ are as clear as it gets

rates.why: a narrow gap over 40 each can't be told apart
a middling gap over 40 each stays preliminary

correlations.why: real but tiny isn't a link
a big r over a short run is still only emerging
a middling r over a short run stays preliminary
